name: Sinsations 2: Modern Gods
source:
In Sinsations 2: Modern Gods you take the role of returning Deadly Sin of Lust, Kosuke, or the Deadly Sin of Lust, Maverick. You're tasked by Lucifer to help clean up the cities of the world by getting rid of Modern Gods that have started appearing. 

Because the world is being influenced by these Modern Gods and Lucifer's Deadly Sins are having less and less influence themselves, Lucifer is commanding all Deadly Sins to get rid of any Modern Gods they come across... By any means necessary.

[From [url=https://whitehand.itch.io/sinsations-2-modern-gods-demo-a-bl-yaoi-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Sinsations 2: Modern Gods》中，你将扮演回归的色欲之罪Kosuke，或另一位色欲之罪Maverick。Lucifer委托你清理各地城市，除掉开始现身的现代诸神。

这些现代诸神正影响着世界，而Lucifer麾下的七宗罪势力也日渐式微。为此，Lucifer命令七宗罪成员全体不惜一切手段，除掉沿途遇见的现代诸神。

[来源：[url=https://whitehand.itch.io/sinsations-2-modern-gods-demo-a-bl-yaoi-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
